{"metadata":{"description":"A manual Terminal tab for the DeepSeek Harness (dsh) web UI — run commands on the host machine, persistent cwd, sudo password prompt, command history.现在可以在web界面内直接执行命令行了","id":"gh:1333867143","install_available":false,"language":"JavaScript","name":"dsh-terminal-panel","slug":"wuwuzhige-sudo/dsh-terminal-panel","topics":["deepseek-harness","dsh","dsh-plugin","dsh-plugins","dsh-terminal","terminal"]},"paragraphs":[{"id":"p1s1","text":"A manual Terminal tab for the DeepSeek Harness (dsh) web UI — run commands on the host machine, pers"},{"id":"p1s2","text":"istent cwd, sudo password prompt, command history.现在可以在web界面内直接执行命令行了"},{"id":"p2s1","text":"# dsh-terminal-panel"},{"id":"p3s1","text":"**Terminal + SFTP** tabs in the DeepSeek Harness (`dsh`) web conversation view. Run commands on the "},{"id":"p3s2","text":"harness host machine directly from the browser — green-on-black classic terminal look, persistent `c"},{"id":"p3s3","text":"wd`, `sudo` password prompt, command history — and browse/transfer files over the same SSH connectio"},{"id":"p3s4","text":"d prompt, command history — and browse/transfer files over the same SSH connection with an SFTP tab."},{"id":"p4s1","text":"## Features"},{"id":"p5s1","text":"- **Terminal tab** in every conversation view (`对话 · 轨迹 · 终端 · SFTP` ordering)
- **SFTP tab** right "},{"id":"p5s2","text":"next to the terminal — file browser over the **same SSH connection** (same host / user / password / "},{"id":"p5s3","text":"key, no second login): navigate directories, upload, download, create directories, delete files and "},{"id":"p5s4","text":"empty directories
- **Manual command execution** on the host machine via the harness `subprocess` se"},{"id":"p5s5","text":"rvice
- **Persistent working directory** — plain `cd` works across commands (`cd ..`, `cd ~/x`, rela"},{"id":"p5s6","text":"tive paths, error messages for bad targets)
- **sudo support** — commands starting with `sudo` run w"},{"id":"p5s7","text":"ith `sudo -S`; the panel masks the password field while sudo is waiting (type it at the bottom line "},{"id":"p5s8","text":"and press Enter)
- **Command history** (↑/↓), **Ctrl+C** to interrupt the running command, **clear s"},{"id":"p5s9","text":"creen**, **reset directory**
- **Two themes** — classic green-on-black and modern black-on-white, to"},{"id":"p5s10","text":"ggled by a button next to the panel controls; the choice persists across reloads (localStorage) and "},{"id":"p5s11","text":"applies to both tabs
- **ANSI escape cleanup** — raw escape sequences never reach the panel
- **Outp"},{"id":"p5s12","text":"ut cap** — 512 KiB rolling buffer, so long-running output cannot blow up memory"},{"id":"p6s1","text":"## Install"},{"id":"p7s1","text":"The plugin ships as a dsh profile plugin. On the machine running `dsh web`:"},{"id":"p8s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p9s1","text":"Then hard-refresh (Ctrl+Shift+R) the `dsh web` page — the **终端** and **SFTP** tabs appear in the con"},{"id":"p9s2","text":"sh (Ctrl+Shift+R) the `dsh web` page — the **终端** and **SFTP** tabs appear in the conversation view."},{"id":"p10s1","text":"## Configuration"},{"id":"p11s1","text":"| Field | Type | Default | Description |"},{"id":"p12s1","text":"| `trustedHosts` | `string[]` | `[]` | Extra hostnames (besides loopback) allowed to call the termin"},{"id":"p12s2","text":"al RPC. Required when the web UI is served through a reverse proxy / Tailscale Serve with a real hos"},{"id":"p12s3","text":"tname. |
| `sshTarget` | `string` | `''` | SSH target for command execution, e.g. `user@127.0.0.1` o"},{"id":"p12s4","text":"r `user@my-server`. Empty = run commands locally. |
| `sshIdentity` | `string` | `~/.ssh/dsh-termina"},{"id":"p12s5","text":"l` | SSH identity file used for `sshTarget`. |
| `sshUser` | `string` | `''` | SSH username when `ss"},{"id":"p12s6","text":"hTarget` holds a bare host. |
| `sshPassword` | `string` | `''` | SSH password (delivered via `SSH_A"},{"id":"p12s7","text":"SKPASS`, never through a pty prompt). Empty = key auth. |"},{"id":"p13s1","text":"### Runtime configuration (no restart needed)"},{"id":"p14s1","text":"Open the **设置** button in either tab (or the first-run setup panel when no
target is configured) and"},{"id":"p14s2","text":" set host / username / password / key path — the
**Terminal and SFTP tabs share this one login**. Se"},{"id":"p14s3","text":"ttings persist in
`~/.local/share/dsh-terminal-panel/config.json` and take effect on the next
comman"},{"id":"p14s4","text":"d — no `cordis.patch.yml` edits or service restarts. The panel lists
the host's detected addresses ("},{"id":"p14s5","text":"Tailscale IP first) for convenience, and a
**one-click key initialisation** for localhost targets."},{"id":"p15s1","text":"### SSH mode (why you want it)"},{"id":"p16s1","text":"When dsh runs sandboxed (bwrap/user namespace — the default on Linux), the
process cannot `setuid`, "},{"id":"p16s2","text":"so **sudo is unusable** in local mode. In SSH mode
the panel keeps **one persistent `ssh -t` session"},{"id":"p16s3","text":" (pseudo-tty)** per terminal,
exactly like an SSH client:"},{"id":"p17s1","text":"- commands run in the **host namespace** of the sshd server → setuid/sudo work
- **sudo asks for the"},{"id":"p17s2","text":" password only once per 15 minutes** (credential cache
is bound to the session's tty, just like a no"},{"id":"p17s3","text":"rmal SSH terminal)
- `cd` and environment persist natively inside the session
- interactive programs"},{"id":"p17s4","text":" (top, htop, …) work
- the same mechanism turns the panel into a remote terminal for **any** SSH hos"},{"id":"p17s5","text":"top, htop, …) work
- the same mechanism turns the panel into a remote terminal for **any** SSH host:"},{"id":"p18s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p19s1","text":"Set up the identity once (one command, no password prompts afterwards):"},{"id":"p20s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p21s1","text":"> In SSH mode a completion marker is emitted after each command so the panel
> knows when the remote"},{"id":"p21s2","text":" command finished (it is stripped from the display).
> Commands reading stdin (e.g. `sudo -S`) keep "},{"id":"p21s3","text":"stdin open — type the password
> in the panel and press Enter; the input is masked."},{"id":"p22s1","text":"## Security"},{"id":"p23s1","text":"> ⚠️ **This plugin executes arbitrary commands on the harness host.** Anyone who can reach the `/sxe"},{"id":"p23s2","text":"c/*` endpoints can run commands as the target user."},{"id":"p24s1","text":"- Requests are accepted **only** from loopback hosts or hosts listed in `trustedHosts` (DNS-rebindin"},{"id":"p24s2","text":"g defence).
- There is **no built-in authentication** — protect the web server itself with a reverse"},{"id":"p24s3","text":"-proxy auth layer (e.g. Caddy `basic_auth`) when exposing it beyond localhost.
- The SSH password (i"},{"id":"p24s4","text":"f configured) is stored in the user-level `config.json` (0600) and delivered to ssh via `SSH_ASKPASS"},{"id":"p24s5","text":"`; prefer key auth on shared machines.
- The endpoint inherits the exposure of whatever fronts the d"},{"id":"p24s6","text":"sh web server: bind it to loopback only, or put an authenticated proxy in front."},{"id":"p25s1","text":"## How it works"},{"id":"p26s1","text":"- **Host half** (`lib/index.js`): a dsh plugin that registers a `/sxec/*` route family on the harnes"},{"id":"p26s2","text":"s webserver (`term-init`, `term-run`, `term-send`, `term-signal`, `term-reset`, `term-read`, `term-c"},{"id":"p26s3","text":"onfig`, `term-init-key`, `sftp-init`, `sftp-list`, `sftp-mkdir`, `sftp-rm`, `sftp-download`, `sftp-u"},{"id":"p26s4","text":"pload`). Commands run either locally via `node:child_process` (bypassing the harness subprocess sand"},{"id":"p26s5","text":"box) or through a persistent `ssh -t` pty session when `sshTarget` is configured; output is ANSI-san"},{"id":"p26s6","text":"itised and buffered. SFTP operations spawn short-lived `sftp -b -` batch processes with the same cre"},{"id":"p26s7","text":"dentials.
- **Client half** (`lib/client.js`): registers the **终端** and **SFTP** slots in `conversat"},{"id":"p26s8","text":"ion.view` and talks to the host via same-origin `fetch('/sxec/*')` calls (no WebSocket, no extra por"},{"id":"p26s9","text":"ts). Both tabs share one settings panel and one theme."}],"truncated":true}
